summary: Wake replication from store authority changes and compare roots before full summaries

replay.detail: Existing replicated records retain their interpretation and replay order.

schema.detail: Revision subscriptions are process-local notifications, not a durable schema migration.

rules.detail: Replication authority, authentication, membership admission and record convergence rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Replication exchanges negotiate root-first summaries. Peers without that capability retain full-summary exchanges; matching capable peers avoid constructing full bucket summaries. Membership notifications are separate from unrelated authority wakes.

downtime.detail: No fleet-wide simultaneous upgrade or data migration is required.

manual.detail: No new configuration is required. Work counts are exposed through the existing performance endpoint.

recovery.detail: A previous binary can resume from the same durable records. Revision subscriptions are recreated when the worker reconnects.
